---
title: "Module 04: Single-cell RNA-seq cell-type annotation with SingleR"
output: html_document
date: "2026-08-06"
---

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# MODULE 04 — SingleR cell-type annotation and marker validation
#==============================================================================

# Purpose:
#   Annotate the processed single-cell dataset using the celldex
#   MouseRNAseqData reference and SingleR. Generate broad and fine cell-level
#   annotations, broad cluster-level annotations, validate major cell types
#   using canonical markers, and identify broad cell-type marker genes.
#
# Input:
#   data/processed/single_cell/GSE298688_processed_clustered_seurat.rds
#
# Output:
#   GSE298688_SingleR_annotated_seurat.rds
#   SingleR prediction objects
#   annotation tables and figures
#   broad cell-type marker results
#
# Notes:
#   Broad labels use MouseRNAseqData label.main.
#   Fine labels use MouseRNAseqData label.fine.
#   Pruned predictions are used for downstream interpretation.
#   "Unassigned" represents predictions removed by SingleR pruning.
#   UMAP is used as the standard nonlinear visualization.


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Setup
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(SingleR)
  library(celldex)
  library(SingleCellExperiment)
  library(SummarizedExperiment)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(here)
})

set.seed(1234)


# Analysis parameters

singleR_fine_tune <- TRUE
singleR_prune <- TRUE

minimum_shared_genes <- 1000

marker_min_pct <- 0.10
marker_log2fc_threshold <- 0.25
adjusted_p_threshold <- 0.05
top_markers_per_cell_type <- 10


# Repository paths

processed_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "single_cell"
)

singleR_object_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "single_cell",
  "singleR"
)

singleR_results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "single_cell",
  "singleR"
)

celltype_marker_results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "single_cell",
  "singleR",
  "cell_type_markers"
)

singleR_figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "single_cell",
  "singleR"
)

diagnostic_figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "single_cell",
  "singleR",
  "diagnostics"
)

celltype_marker_figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "single_cell",
  "singleR",
  "cell_type_markers"
)

celltype_volcano_figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "single_cell",
  "singleR",
  "cell_type_markers",
  "volcano_plots"
)


for (directory in c(
  singleR_object_directory,
  singleR_results_directory,
  celltype_marker_results_directory,
  singleR_figure_directory,
  diagnostic_figure_directory,
  celltype_marker_figure_directory,
  celltype_volcano_figure_directory
)) {

  dir.create(
    directory,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
}


input_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "GSE298688_processed_clustered_seurat.rds"
)

annotated_object_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "GSE298688_SingleR_annotated_seurat.rds"
)


# Helper for consistently saving figures.

save_plot <- function(
  plot,
  directory,
  filename,
  width = 7,
  height = 6
) {

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      directory,
      filename
    ),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = 300
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Load processed single-cell object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!file.exists(input_file)) {
  stop(
    "Module 03 output not found: ",
    input_file
  )
}

message("Loading processed single-cell object...")

single_cell <- readRDS(
  input_file
)

DefaultAssay(single_cell) <- "RNA"


required_metadata <- c(
  "sample",
  "condition",
  "seurat_clusters"
)

missing_metadata <- setdiff(
  required_metadata,
  colnames(single_cell@meta.data)
)

if (length(missing_metadata) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required metadata: ",
    paste(
      missing_metadata,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}


if (!"umap" %in% Reductions(single_cell)) {
  stop(
    "Final UMAP reduction was not found. Run Module 03 first."
  )
}


# Join Seurat v5 RNA layers before conversion to SingleCellExperiment.

if (
  length(
    Layers(
      single_cell[["RNA"]]
    )
  ) > 1
) {

  message("Joining RNA assay layers...")

  single_cell <- JoinLayers(
    single_cell,
    assay = "RNA"
  )
}


message(
  "Loaded: ",
  nrow(single_cell),
  " genes x ",
  ncol(single_cell),
  " cells"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Prepare SingleR query and reference
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

message("Loading celldex MouseRNAseqData reference...")

mouse_reference <- celldex::MouseRNAseqData()


single_cell_sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(
  single_cell,
  assay = "RNA"
)


if (
  !"logcounts" %in%
    SummarizedExperiment::assayNames(
      single_cell_sce
    )
) {

  stop(
    "SingleCellExperiment does not contain a logcounts assay."
  )
}


# Check query-reference gene overlap before annotation.

shared_genes <- intersect(
  rownames(single_cell_sce),
  rownames(mouse_reference)
)

gene_overlap_percent <-
  100 * length(shared_genes) /
  nrow(single_cell_sce)


gene_overlap_table <- data.frame(
  query_genes = nrow(single_cell_sce),
  reference_genes = nrow(mouse_reference),
  shared_genes = length(shared_genes),
  query_overlap_percent = gene_overlap_percent
)


print(gene_overlap_table)


write.csv(
  gene_overlap_table,
  file.path(
    singleR_results_directory,
    "GSE298688_SingleR_query_reference_gene_overlap.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


if (length(shared_genes) < minimum_shared_genes) {

  warning(
    "Low query-reference gene overlap. Check species and gene identifiers."
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Run cell-level SingleR annotation
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

message("Running broad cell-level SingleR annotation...")

singleR_broad <- SingleR(
  test = single_cell_sce,
  ref = mouse_reference,
  labels = mouse_reference$label.main,
  assay.type.test = "logcounts",
  assay.type.ref = "logcounts",
  fine.tune = singleR_fine_tune,
  prune = singleR_prune
)


message("Running fine cell-level SingleR annotation...")

singleR_fine <- SingleR(
  test = single_cell_sce,
  ref = mouse_reference,
  labels = mouse_reference$label.fine,
  assay.type.test = "logcounts",
  assay.type.ref = "logcounts",
  fine.tune = singleR_fine_tune,
  prune = singleR_prune
)


# Reorder predictions to match the Seurat object.

singleR_broad <- singleR_broad[
  colnames(single_cell),
]

singleR_fine <- singleR_fine[
  colnames(single_cell),
]


# Add predictions to Seurat metadata.

singleR_metadata <- data.frame(

  SingleR_broad_label =
    singleR_broad$labels,

  SingleR_broad_pruned =
    singleR_broad$pruned.labels,

  SingleR_broad_delta =
    singleR_broad$delta.next,

  SingleR_fine_label =
    singleR_fine$labels,

  SingleR_fine_pruned =
    singleR_fine$pruned.labels,

  SingleR_fine_delta =
    singleR_fine$delta.next,

  row.names = colnames(single_cell)
)


# Replace pruned NA values with an explicit category.

singleR_metadata$SingleR_broad_pruned[
  is.na(singleR_metadata$SingleR_broad_pruned)
] <- "Unassigned"

singleR_metadata$SingleR_fine_pruned[
  is.na(singleR_metadata$SingleR_fine_pruned)
] <- "Unassigned"


single_cell <- AddMetaData(
  single_cell,
  metadata = singleR_metadata
)


message("Cell-level SingleR annotation complete.")


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Run broad cluster-level SingleR annotation
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cluster_ids <- as.character(
  single_cell$seurat_clusters
)


message("Running broad cluster-level SingleR annotation...")

singleR_cluster <- SingleR(
  test = single_cell_sce,
  ref = mouse_reference,
  labels = mouse_reference$label.main,
  clusters = cluster_ids,
  assay.type.test = "logcounts",
  assay.type.ref = "logcounts",
  fine.tune = singleR_fine_tune,
  prune = singleR_prune
)


cluster_label_map <- setNames(
  singleR_cluster$labels,
  rownames(singleR_cluster)
)

cluster_pruned_map <- setNames(
  singleR_cluster$pruned.labels,
  rownames(singleR_cluster)
)


single_cell$SingleR_cluster_label <-
  unname(
    cluster_label_map[
      as.character(
        single_cell$seurat_clusters
      )
    ]
  )


single_cell$SingleR_cluster_pruned <-
  unname(
    cluster_pruned_map[
      as.character(
        single_cell$seurat_clusters
      )
    ]
  )


single_cell$SingleR_cluster_pruned[
  is.na(single_cell$SingleR_cluster_pruned)
] <- "Unassigned"


cluster_annotation_summary <- data.frame(
  cluster = rownames(singleR_cluster),
  label = singleR_cluster$labels,
  pruned_label = singleR_cluster$pruned.labels
)

cluster_annotation_summary$pruned_label[
  is.na(cluster_annotation_summary$pruned_label)
] <- "Unassigned"


print(cluster_annotation_summary)


write.csv(
  cluster_annotation_summary,
  file.path(
    singleR_results_directory,
    "GSE298688_SingleR_cluster_level_predictions.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Visualize SingleR annotations
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# UMAP is used throughout the protocol as the standard nonlinear
# visualization.

singleR_broad_umap <- DimPlot(
  single_cell,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "SingleR_broad_pruned",
  label = TRUE,
  repel = TRUE
) +
  ggtitle(
    "SingleR Broad Cell-Type Annotation"
  )


singleR_fine_umap <- DimPlot(
  single_cell,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "SingleR_fine_pruned",
  label = TRUE,
  repel = TRUE
) +
  ggtitle(
    "SingleR Fine Cell-Type Annotation"
  )


singleR_cluster_umap <- DimPlot(
  single_cell,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "SingleR_cluster_pruned",
  label = TRUE,
  repel = TRUE
) +
  ggtitle(
    "SingleR Cluster-Level Annotation"
  )


print(singleR_broad_umap)
print(singleR_fine_umap)
print(singleR_cluster_umap)


save_plot(
  singleR_broad_umap,
  singleR_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_SingleR_broad_cell_level_UMAP.png"
)

save_plot(
  singleR_fine_umap,
  singleR_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_SingleR_fine_cell_level_UMAP.png"
)

save_plot(
  singleR_cluster_umap,
  singleR_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_SingleR_cluster_level_UMAP.png"
)


# Combined annotation overview.
# Save directly because the three-panel patchwork may be too large for the
# interactive RStudio plotting device.

singleR_annotation_overview <- (
  singleR_broad_umap |
  singleR_fine_umap |
  singleR_cluster_umap
)

save_plot(
  singleR_annotation_overview,
  singleR_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_SingleR_annotation_overview.png",
  width = 18,
  height = 6
)

message(
  "Saved combined SingleR annotation overview."
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Examine annotation confidence and composition
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# SingleR delta distributions provide a useful diagnostic of prediction
# confidence.

singleR_broad_delta_plot <- plotDeltaDistribution(
  singleR_broad,
  ncol = 3
)

singleR_fine_delta_plot <- plotDeltaDistribution(
  singleR_fine,
  ncol = 3
)


print(singleR_broad_delta_plot)
print(singleR_fine_delta_plot)


save_plot(
  singleR_broad_delta_plot,
  diagnostic_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_SingleR_broad_delta_distribution.png",
  width = 12,
  height = 8
)

save_plot(
  singleR_fine_delta_plot,
  diagnostic_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_SingleR_fine_delta_distribution.png",
  width = 12,
  height = 8
)


# Cluster-level score heatmap.

singleR_score_heatmap <- plotScoreHeatmap(
  singleR_cluster
)

print(singleR_score_heatmap)


png(
  filename = file.path(
    diagnostic_figure_directory,
    "GSE298688_SingleR_cluster_level_score_heatmap.png"
  ),
  width = 2400,
  height = 1800,
  res = 300
)

print(singleR_score_heatmap)

dev.off()


# Summarize broad and fine cell-type counts.

broad_cell_type_counts <- single_cell@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(
    SingleR_broad_pruned,
    name = "n_cells"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(n_cells)
  )


fine_cell_type_counts <- single_cell@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(
    SingleR_fine_pruned,
    name = "n_cells"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(n_cells)
  )


write.csv(
  broad_cell_type_counts,
  file.path(
    singleR_results_directory,
    "GSE298688_SingleR_broad_cell_type_counts.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  fine_cell_type_counts,
  file.path(
    singleR_results_directory,
    "GSE298688_SingleR_fine_cell_type_counts.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# Examine broad SingleR composition within Seurat clusters.

broad_cluster_percent <- single_cell@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(
    seurat_clusters,
    SingleR_broad_pruned,
    name = "n_cells"
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    seurat_clusters
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    percent_of_cluster =
      100 * n_cells / sum(n_cells)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


write.csv(
  broad_cluster_percent,
  file.path(
    singleR_results_directory,
    "GSE298688_SingleR_broad_cell_types_by_cluster.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


cluster_cell_type_plot <- ggplot(
  broad_cluster_percent,
  aes(
    x = seurat_clusters,
    y = percent_of_cluster,
    fill = SingleR_broad_pruned
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "SingleR Cell-Type Composition of Seurat Clusters",
    x = "Seurat cluster",
    y = "Cells within cluster (%)",
    fill = "SingleR cell type"
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 12
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    )
  )


print(cluster_cell_type_plot)


save_plot(
  cluster_cell_type_plot,
  singleR_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_SingleR_cell_types_by_cluster.png",
  width = 10,
  height = 6
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Validate broad annotations using canonical markers
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Multiple markers are used for each major lineage because no individual
# marker should be treated as definitive evidence of cell identity.

canonical_markers_by_celltype <- list(

  Microglia = c(
    "P2ry12",
    "Tmem119",
    "Hexb",
    "Sall1"
  ),

  Monocytes = c(
    "Lyz2",
    "Ccr2",
    "Ly6c2",
    "Ctss"
  ),

  `T cells` = c(
    "Cd3d",
    "Cd3e",
    "Trbc1",
    "Lck"
  ),

  `NK cells` = c(
    "Nkg7",
    "Klrd1",
    "Ncr1",
    "Prf1"
  ),

  `B cells` = c(
    "Cd79a",
    "Ms4a1",
    "Cd74",
    "Cd37"
  ),

  Granulocytes = c(
    "S100a8",
    "S100a9",
    "Csf3r",
    "Mpo"
  ),

  Erythrocytes = c(
    "Hba-a1",
    "Hba-a2",
    "Hbb-bs",
    "Alas2"
  ),

  `Epithelial cells` = c(
    "Epcam",
    "Krt8",
    "Krt18",
    "Krt19"
  )
)


canonical_markers <- unique(
  unlist(
    canonical_markers_by_celltype,
    use.names = FALSE
  )
)


canonical_markers_present <- intersect(
  canonical_markers,
  rownames(single_cell)
)


if (length(canonical_markers_present) == 0) {
  stop(
    "None of the predefined canonical marker genes were found."
  )
}


marker_dotplot <- DotPlot(
  single_cell,
  features = canonical_markers_present,
  group.by = "SingleR_broad_pruned"
) +
  RotatedAxis() +
  labs(
    title = "Canonical Marker Expression Across SingleR Cell Types",
    x = "Canonical marker",
    y = "SingleR cell type"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    )
  )


print(marker_dotplot)


save_plot(
  marker_dotplot,
  singleR_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_SingleR_canonical_marker_dotplot.png",
  width = 14,
  height = 8
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Broad SingleR cell-type differential expression
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Use confidently annotated broad cell types for marker analysis.
# Cells removed by SingleR pruning are excluded.

annotation_column <- "SingleR_broad_pruned"


single_cell_de <- subset(
  single_cell,
  subset = SingleR_broad_pruned != "Unassigned"
)


if (ncol(single_cell_de) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No confidently annotated cells remained for cell-type DEA."
  )
}


DefaultAssay(single_cell_de) <- "RNA"
Idents(single_cell_de) <- annotation_column


# Join normalized RNA layers if required by Seurat v5.

rna_layers_dea <- Layers(
  single_cell_de[["RNA"]]
)

if (
  sum(
    grepl(
      "^data",
      rna_layers_dea
    )
  ) > 1
) {

  single_cell_de <- JoinLayers(
    single_cell_de,
    assay = "RNA"
  )
}


message(
  "Running broad SingleR cell-type differential expression..."
)


singleR_celltype_markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  object = single_cell_de,
  assay = "RNA",
  only.pos = FALSE,
  min.pct = marker_min_pct,
  logfc.threshold = marker_log2fc_threshold,
  test.use = "wilcox",
  verbose = FALSE
)


if (nrow(singleR_celltype_markers) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No SingleR cell-type marker genes were identified."
  )
}


if (!"gene" %in% colnames(singleR_celltype_markers)) {
  singleR_celltype_markers$gene <-
    rownames(singleR_celltype_markers)
}


write.csv(
  singleR_celltype_markers,
  file.path(
    celltype_marker_results_directory,
    "GSE298688_SingleR_broad_cell_type_markers_all.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# Summarize significant markers.

singleR_marker_summary <- singleR_celltype_markers %>%
  group_by(
    cluster
  ) %>%
  summarise(

    total_markers = n(),

    positive_markers = sum(
      avg_log2FC > 0 &
        p_val_adj < adjusted_p_threshold,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    negative_markers = sum(
      avg_log2FC < 0 &
        p_val_adj < adjusted_p_threshold,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


print(singleR_marker_summary)


write.csv(
  singleR_marker_summary,
  file.path(
    celltype_marker_results_directory,
    "GSE298688_SingleR_broad_cell_type_marker_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# Select top positive markers for visualization.

singleR_top_markers <- singleR_celltype_markers %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(p_val_adj),
    p_val_adj < adjusted_p_threshold,
    avg_log2FC > 0
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    cluster
  ) %>%
  slice_max(
    order_by = avg_log2FC,
    n = top_markers_per_cell_type,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


if (nrow(singleR_top_markers) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No significant positive SingleR cell-type markers were available."
  )
}


write.csv(
  singleR_top_markers,
  file.path(
    celltype_marker_results_directory,
    "GSE298688_SingleR_broad_top10_cell_type_markers.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Visualize broad cell-type markers
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

celltype_heatmap_genes <- intersect(
  unique(
    singleR_top_markers$gene
  ),
  rownames(single_cell_de)
)


single_cell_de <- ScaleData(
  single_cell_de,
  assay = "RNA",
  features = celltype_heatmap_genes,
  verbose = FALSE
)


singleR_celltype_heatmap <- DoHeatmap(
  single_cell_de,
  features = celltype_heatmap_genes,
  group.by = annotation_column,
  size = 3
) +
  NoLegend()


print(singleR_celltype_heatmap)


save_plot(
  singleR_celltype_heatmap,
  celltype_marker_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_SingleR_broad_top10_cell_type_marker_heatmap.png",
  width = 14,
  height = 12
)


# Generate one volcano plot for each broad SingleR cell type.

singleR_cell_types <- sort(
  unique(
    singleR_celltype_markers$cluster
  )
)


message(
  "Generating volcano plots for ",
  length(singleR_cell_types),
  " broad cell types..."
)


for (cell_type in singleR_cell_types) {

  cell_type_de <- singleR_celltype_markers %>%
    filter(
      cluster == cell_type
    ) %>%
    mutate(

      significance = case_when(

        !is.na(p_val_adj) &
          p_val_adj < adjusted_p_threshold &
          avg_log2FC >= marker_log2fc_threshold ~
          "Upregulated",

        !is.na(p_val_adj) &
          p_val_adj < adjusted_p_threshold &
          avg_log2FC <= -marker_log2fc_threshold ~
          "Downregulated",

        TRUE ~
          "Not significant"
      ),

      plot_p = if_else(
        is.na(p_val_adj),
        NA_real_,
        pmax(
          p_val_adj,
          .Machine$double.xmin
        )
      ),

      neg_log10_p = -log10(
        plot_p
      )
    )


  volcano_labels <- cell_type_de %>%
    filter(
      significance == "Upregulated"
    ) %>%
    slice_max(
      order_by = avg_log2FC,
      n = top_markers_per_cell_type,
      with_ties = FALSE
    )


  volcano_plot <- ggplot(
    cell_type_de,
    aes(
      x = avg_log2FC,
      y = neg_log10_p
    )
  ) +

    geom_point(
      aes(
        color = significance
      ),
      alpha = 0.65,
      size = 1.5
    ) +

    geom_vline(
      xintercept = c(
        -marker_log2fc_threshold,
        marker_log2fc_threshold
      ),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(
        adjusted_p_threshold
      ),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = volcano_labels,
      aes(
        label = gene
      ),
      size = 3.2,
      box.padding = 0.4,
      point.padding = 0.2,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Upregulated" = "#D73027",
        "Downregulated" = "#4575B4",
        "Not significant" = "grey70"
      )
    ) +

    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "Differential Expression of ",
        cell_type
      ),
      subtitle =
        "SingleR cell type compared with all remaining annotated cells",
      x = "Average log2 fold change",
      y = expression(
        -log[10](
          "adjusted p-value"
        )
      ),
      color = NULL
    ) +

    theme_classic(
      base_size = 12
    ) +

    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 14
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 11,
        color = "grey35"
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(
        face = "bold"
      ),
      legend.position = "top"
    )


  print(volcano_plot)


  safe_cell_type <- gsub(
    "[^A-Za-z0-9]+",
    "_",
    cell_type
  )


  save_plot(
    volcano_plot,
    celltype_volcano_figure_directory,
    paste0(
      "GSE298688_SingleR_",
      safe_cell_type,
      "_volcano.png"
    ),
    width = 7,
    height = 6
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Save analysis parameters and objects
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

singleR_parameters <- data.frame(

  parameter = c(
    "reference",
    "broad_reference_label",
    "fine_reference_label",
    "cell_level_annotation",
    "cluster_level_annotation",
    "fine_tune",
    "prune",
    "minimum_shared_genes",
    "marker_identity",
    "marker_test",
    "marker_min_pct",
    "marker_log2fc_threshold",
    "adjusted_p_threshold",
    "top_markers_per_cell_type",
    "visualization"
  ),

  value = c(
    "celldex::MouseRNAseqData",
    "label.main",
    "label.fine",
    "Broad and fine",
    "Broad",
    singleR_fine_tune,
    singleR_prune,
    minimum_shared_genes,
    annotation_column,
    "Wilcoxon",
    marker_min_pct,
    marker_log2fc_threshold,
    adjusted_p_threshold,
    top_markers_per_cell_type,
    "UMAP"
  ),

  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


write.csv(
  singleR_parameters,
  file.path(
    singleR_results_directory,
    "GSE298688_SingleR_parameters.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# Save prediction objects for reuse in downstream modules.

saveRDS(
  singleR_broad,
  file.path(
    singleR_object_directory,
    "GSE298688_SingleR_cell_level_broad_predictions.rds"
  )
)

saveRDS(
  singleR_fine,
  file.path(
    singleR_object_directory,
    "GSE298688_SingleR_cell_level_fine_predictions.rds"
  )
)

saveRDS(
  singleR_cluster,
  file.path(
    singleR_object_directory,
    "GSE298688_SingleR_cluster_level_predictions.rds"
  )
)


# Save annotated Seurat object.

saveRDS(
  single_cell,
  annotated_object_file
)


message(
  "Module 04 complete: ",
  ncol(single_cell),
  " cells annotated using SingleR."
)

message(
  "Saved annotated object: ",
  annotated_object_file
)
```
